title: Ramayana — Uttara Kanda
author: valmiki
attributionNote: Traditionally attributed to Valmiki. The book is the last of the seven kandas of the Ramayana and is part of the epic as it has come down, though its date and its relation to the earlier six books are debated.
description: The seventh and last book of the Ramayana: Rama's rule at Ayodhya, the birth of his sons, the Ashvamedha, the return of Sita, her final disappearance into the earth, and the deaths and aftermath that close the epic. Dutt's prose translation is complete for this volume and follows the printed section divisions.
historicalContext: Griffith's verse translation in this library ends with the sixth book, so the Uttara Kanda is read here in Manmatha Nath Dutt's 1894 prose rendering. It is kept as its own record so that the two translations are not conflated; the earlier six books remain in Griffith's verse.
availabilityNote: Complete. Dutt's prose translation of the Uttara Kanda, streamed from Project Gutenberg at read time, one section per chapter. The printed section numerals are irregular after section C — the transcription concatenates the century numeral with the following one — so chapters are numbered in reading order and the editor's reading is stated rather than reproduced.
